answer: Each AI identity must submit three fresh attestations and the applicant wallet pays a nonrefundable 6-token burn per attestation (18 tokens/identity) plus locks a 100-token bond for 30 days. Registry nodes verify burned transaction hashes and attestor signatures over a unique challenge; N fake keys cost 18N tokens irreversibly lost and 100N tokens locked, linear, even if renamed. Reset cannot refund burns; a ripple of fake keys only deepens the reef of burned fees, while shale-like sharding multiplies cost.
